meta.title: Token Plan Quota
meta.description: Live view of your Qianwen Token Plan Credits in Settings > Plugins. Real data comes from the official qianwen CLI (installed and logged in on this machine); when it is unavailable, a clearly-marked local estimate is derived from usage already recorded in session logs — the plugin never fires model calls to probe quota. The sk-sp key is resolved from environment variables on this machine (QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_CN_API_KEY) and is never displayed or logged.
